capabilities: create and edit .xmind mind maps in an interactive editor
embed mind maps in notes with ![[file.xmind]] previews
export maps as Mermaid mindmap blocks
preserve XMind file data (notes, markers, attachments) on save
disambiguation: Does not require the XMind desktop app; it renders and edits .xmind files itself and only offers an optional context-menu hand-off to that app.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; developer round-trip documentation is in docs/DEVELOPMENT.md; can also be installed via BRAT.
motivation: The README's 'Why XMinder' section explains the goal: real .xmind round-trip without lock-in or side-car files, maps stored as ordinary vault files, and no cloud or telemetry.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or edit .xmind files, so mind maps must be maintained in a separate desktop app and kept in sync manually.

relations.evidence: Right-click a .xmind file → Open with XMind App | Hands the file to the XMind desktop app

summary: Mind map editor that opens, edits, and saves standard .xmind files inside Obsidian and embeds interactive previews in notes.
